goal: Speed up wallet fast rescans by checking compact block filters across multiple CPU cores in parallel
Reduces wait times significantly during descriptor imports and wallet restores on multi-core systems
reviewability: Open review questions on argument bounds and scan refactoring invite further reviewer input
agreement: Strong support with multiple benchmarks verifying major rescan speedups across thread counts
Verified by testing a 4.5x to 6x rescan speedup across 16 threads (ismaelsadeeq)
Verified by testing a 3x rescan speedup on an HDD setup (l0rinc)
Strong concept support after task contention was resolved with dedicated thread pools (rkrux)
Concept approval with open suggestions on argument validation and error types (polespinasa)
